name: Zhejiang Zomax Transmission Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Zomax Transmission Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of automotive transmissions and vehicle gears in China and internationally. The company offers automotive transmissions, new energy vehicle reducers, electronically controlled transfer cases, motorcycle gear, and agricultural machinery gear; and automobile gear, including automobile manual transmission gear, wheel and automatic transmission gear, new energy vehicle reducer gear, automotive steering gear, automotive oil pump shaft gear, and automotive engines, as well as motorcycle engine gears, and agricultural machinery transmission gears.
